formula: L*(2*d*d + 2*d*KVdim + 3*d*FFN) + vocab*d for a decode position; tied embedding/output table. Benchmark with no EOS: (input_tokens+15)*transformer +16*head.
exclusions: Attention score/value products varying with position, norms including Supra Q/K norm, activations, RoPE, sampling, pauses, scheduler, communication and memory traffic.
scope: Analytical matrix work only; not observed instructions, memory bandwidth, energy or a latency prediction. Model architectures are not isolated causal variables.
